# Best AI for Techs

> Best AI for trade technicians and small shops, sorted by job: troubleshooting, parts, quotes, paperwork and call answering. 17 tools with prices and sources.

Published by Kenner Systems Inc. (https://getkenner.com/), which makes one of the tools compared. Vendor facts checked on 10 November 2026.

## The short answer

Pick the job first. For troubleshooting, Bluon and FixBot Pro answer from the manuals for HVAC, and MyPros+ does the same for appliances. For parts, Parts Town's PartPredictor and MyPros+ get you to the part number. For quotes, ServiceM8, Jobber and FieldPulse draft them inside the software you may already run. For the write-up, CompanyCam and ServiceM8. For the phone, the receptionists in Jobber, Housecall Pro and Workiz, or Avoca. If you want troubleshooting, parts, quotes and the write-up from one assistant, that is Kenner, which we make: it does all four because it sits on top of your own service records.

- Troubleshooting, parts, quotes and the write-up in one, for teams: Kenner (https://getkenner.com/)
- Shops that run on ServiceTitan: ServiceTitan Atlas (https://www.servicetitan.com/features/atlas)
- HVAC troubleshooting by model: Bluon MasterMechanic (https://www.bluon.com/)
- Troubleshooting from the service manual, at a low price: FixBot Pro (https://fixbot.pro/hvac)
- A single HVAC technician: HVAC/R AI Pro (https://hvacrai.com/)
- Appliance repair: MyPros+ (https://www.mypros.plus/)
- Finding the part: Parts Town PartPredictor and SnapScan (https://www.partstown.com/part-predictor)
- A small shop that wants quotes, invoices and the phone in one app: ServiceM8 AI features (https://www.servicem8.com/feature-overview)
- Quotes drafted and the phone answered, on Jobber: Jobber AI (https://www.getjobber.com/features/ai/)
- An office assistant that drafts estimates: FieldPulse Field Intelligence (https://www.fieldpulse.com/features/field-intelligence)
- Estimates for remodels and installs: Handoff (https://www.handoff.ai/)
- The job write-up from photos: CompanyCam AI (https://companycam.com/features/ai)
- Electricians: Kopperfield (https://www.kopperfield.com/)
- Calls answered, on Housecall Pro: Housecall Pro AI Team (https://www.housecallpro.com/features/ai-team/)
- Calls answered and the technician assigned: Workiz Genius (https://www.workiz.com/features/genius-answering/)
- Call answering for ServiceTitan shops: Avoca (https://www.avoca.ai/)
- A free general assistant: ChatGPT (https://chatgpt.com/)
